issues: 正视平铺的彩色描边字铺满黑底，像网页背景动画，没有"灯牌"的空间与材质
三行余弦包络之间有全暗空拍，亮行峰值只有一瞬，大部分时间画面整体偏暗
Arial Black 宽体 + 实心圆点分隔，字形笨重；BETTER/FASTER/STRONGER 是现成歌词口号
结尾整组淡到纯黑，尾帧是一张黑屏
changes: look 改 custom「neon」：一面蓝黑砖墙放进 3D 平面斜拍（rotateY −17°→−9° 全程极缓摇近），墙脚加湿地面——最下一行的翻转倒影 + 三色地面光池
灯管三层：暗态同色玻璃管常亮 → 通电管体 + 三层辉光 → 近白热芯；亮行同时把同色光溢到砖墙上照出砖缝，读作"墙上的灯"
字体换 Avenir Next Condensed Heavy 286px，三连词改为头韵 DRAFT / DESIGN / DEPLOY，分隔换空心菱形，词距按实测宽度等距
轮唱改 42f 周期、14f 槽 + 2f 交接重叠，每次点亮先打 2 帧启辉闪烁再升满——永远一亮俩暗、没有全暗空拍
开场三行错峰 5f 依次点火上电；124f 起自上而下逐行闪两下断电，尾帧是暗态灯管仍可见的熄灯海报
issuesEn: Flat, front-on coloured outline type tiled over black, reading as a web background animation with no sense of a physical sign
The cosine envelopes left fully dark gaps between rows and each peak lasted an instant, so the frame was dim most of the time
Wide Arial Black with solid dot separators felt clumsy, and BETTER/FASTER/STRONGER is a borrowed lyric
The whole group faded to pure black, so the last frame was a black screen
changesEn: Custom neon look: a blue-black brick wall in a 3D plane shot at an angle (rotateY −17°→−9° slow drift throughout), with a wet floor carrying a mirrored reflection of the bottom row and coloured light pools

Three-layer tubes: a dim same-colour glass tube always on, a powered tube with three glow layers, and a near-white hot core; the lit row also spills its colour onto the bricks, so it reads as light on a wall
Avenir Next Condensed Heavy at 286px, an alliterative recap DRAFT / DESIGN / DEPLOY, hollow diamond separators and measured, even word spacing
Round-robin is now a 42f cycle with 14f slots and a 2f overlap handoff; each ignition opens with a 2f strike flicker, so there is always one lit row and never a dark gap
The rows strike on 5f apart at the start; from 124f they cut out top to bottom with two flickers each, ending on an unlit-sign poster where the dark tubes stay visible
